points.quote: They generate text that is not always factually correct. A knowledgeable human must check the output.
points.anchor: Risks of over-reliance on generative AI
points.gist: Generated text is not always correct and a knowledgeable human must check the output.

points.quote: A human trained in that programming language should fully check any code or calculation produced in this way.
points.anchor: Risks of over-reliance on generative AI
points.gist: Someone trained in the programming language should fully check any AI-produced code or calculation.

points.quote: They can occasionally produce fake citations and references.
points.anchor: Risks of over-reliance on generative AI
points.gist: AI tools can occasionally produce fake citations and references.

points.quote: Importantly, overreliance on AI tools simply to generate written content, software code or analysis reduces your opportunity to develop and practice key skills (e.g. writing, critical thinking, evaluation, analysis, coding, reasoning).
points.anchor: Risks of over-reliance on generative AI
points.gist: Over-reliance on AI to generate writing, code or analysis reduces the chance to develop and practise key skills.

points.quote: Environmental costs. Generative AI systems consume a substantial amount of energy, require large amount of water to cool their processors and generate electricity, and lead to significant carbon emissions.
points.anchor: Disadvantages of using AI in academic work
points.gist: Generative AI uses substantial energy and large amounts of water and leads to significant carbon emissions.

points.quote: They include hidden plagiarism – meaning that they make use of words and ideas from human authors without referencing them.
points.anchor: Risks of over-reliance on generative AI
points.gist: AI tools can contain hidden plagiarism by using human authors' words and ideas without referencing them.

points.quote: Generative AI may use illegal libraries and material generated from AI may infringe copyright or intellectual property.
points.anchor: Risks of over-reliance on generative AI
points.gist: AI may use illegal libraries and its output may infringe copyright or intellectual property.

points.quote: Part seven of our self-enrol Study Skills Canvas module focuses on generative AI.
points.anchor: Want to learn more about generative AI for your studies?
points.gist: Part seven of the self-enrol Study Skills Canvas module covers generative AI.

points.quote: Such systems are amoral – they do not know that it is wrong to generate offensive, inaccurate or misleading content, and sometimes do so.
points.anchor: Risks of over-reliance on generative AI
points.gist: These systems do not know it is wrong to generate offensive, inaccurate or misleading content and sometimes do so.
